summary: This section sets out the statutory definition of dismissal for the relevant Part of the Act, establishing that an employee is dismissed if the employer terminates the contract, if a limited-term contract expires without renewal, or if the employee resigns in response to the employer's conduct. It excludes resignations without notice that occur due to an employer lock-out. It also deems an employee dismissed where they give written counter-notice to leave early during the obligatory notice period, or where an act or event affecting the employer terminates the contract by operation of law.

elements.requirement: The employment contract is ended by the employer, with or without notice.
elements.quote: terminated by the employer (whether with or without notice)

elements.requirement: A limited term contract ends by its limiting event without renewal under the same contract.
elements.quote: terminates by virtue of the limiting event without being renewed under the same contract

elements.requirement: The employee terminates the contract in circumstances where they are entitled to terminate without notice due to the employer's conduct.
elements.quote: entitled to terminate it without notice by reason of the employer’s conduct

elements.requirement: Constructive dismissal does not apply if the employee terminates without notice due to an employer lock-out.
elements.quote: does not apply if the employee terminates the contract without notice in circumstances in which he is entitled to do so by reason of a lock-out by the employer

elements.requirement: After receiving employer notice, the employee gives written notice within the obligatory notice period to terminate on an earlier date.
elements.quote: at a time within the obligatory period of notice the employee gives notice in writing to the employer to terminate the contract of employment on a date earlier than the date on which the employer’s notice is due to expire

thresholds.what: Obligatory period of notice where actual notice equals the minimum required notice
thresholds.value: Equal to the minimum required period
thresholds.quote: equal to the minimum period which (by virtue of any enactment or otherwise) is required to be given by the employer to terminate the contract of employment
